correctness.rationale: For q=n-1>=4 and n>=5 open paths, a time-t excited state has a backward nonbacktracking ancestry path, hence t<=n-1; each site returns to rest by q-1 additional steps, so tau<=2n-3. Attaining this requires an endpoint-to-endpoint wave with a0=1, interior a_i=0 or refractory c>=q-i+1, and the far-end initially excited/penultimate-zero collision is the sole veto. The two orientation sets are disjoint; multiplying interior factors and the far-end choices gives 2*prod_{j=0}^{n-4}(1+jz)*[(1+(n-3)z)^2+(n-3)zu] and count 2((n-1)!-(n-3)!). Independently evolved every labelled state for n=5,q=4 and n=6,q=5, finding 44=36+8 and 228=192+36 maximal one-source/two-source states. Those computations corroborate, but the nonbacktracking and local necessity/sufficiency establish the infinite family.
